translation.name: Biblica® Ochiw Thuolo Motingʼo Loko Manyien™

content.text: Ngʼat masiko katoke tek bangʼ siem mangʼeny
ibiro tieko apoya nono maonge konyruok.
Ka joma kare dhiyo nyime, ji mor,
ka joricho ema otelo e loch ji ywak ka gichur.
Ngʼat mohero rieko miyo wuon mare mor,
to ngʼat momako osiep kod jachode ketho mwandune.
Gi adiera ema ruoth miyo piny bet mochungʼ motegno,
to ngʼat mawuor ne asoya muke magoye piny.
Ngʼat mawuondo jabute
ochiko obadho e tiende.
Ngʼat marach dwodore e obadho mar richone owuon,
to ngʼat makare nyalo wer mobed mamor.
Ngʼat makare winjo ywak jochan mondo otimnegi gima kare,
to ngʼat marach ok dew gimoro.
Joma jaro ji kelo koko e dala,
to jomariek ringo aa e mirima.
Ka ngʼat mariek odhiyo gi ngʼat mofuwo e od bura,
to ngʼat mofuwo goyo koko kendo jero,
kendo kwe bedo maonge.
Joma ohero chwero remo mon kod jogo modimbore,
kendo gidwaro yo mar nego joma jo-ratiro.
Ngʼat mofuwo chiwore duto komwomore amwoma e mirimbe,
to ngʼat mariek ritore ka ogare.
Ka ruoth thoro chiko ite ne miriambo,
to jootene duto bedo joma timbegi richo.
Jachan gi ngʼat mahinyo ji nigi gimoro achiel machalre:
Jehova Nyasaye miyogi wenge maneno kargi ji ariyogo.
Ka ruoth ongʼado bura ne jochan kod adiera,
kom ruodhe biro bedo moritore ma ok hinyre.
Ka ichwado nyathi kendo ikwere eka ikonye bedo mariek
to nyathi ma owe aweya kelo wichkuot ne min mare.
Ka jaricho dhiyo nyime maber, e kaka richo bende medore,
to joma kare biro neno podho margi.
Kum wuodi, to obiro miyi kwe;
kendo obiro kelo mor ne chunyi.
Kama onge lek, to ji chunygi aa
to ngʼama orito chik en ngʼat mogwedhi.
Misumba ok nyal kony kirieye mana gi wach kende;
kata bed ni owinjo, to ok obi rwako.
Bende ineno ngʼato ma wuoyo ka rikni mapiyo piyo?
Nitie geno mathoth kuom ngʼat mofuwo maloye.
Ka ngʼato omiyo misumbane gik moko duto chakre ka en rawera,
obiro kelo kuyo e gikone.
Ngʼat ma iye owangʼ kelo masira,
to ngʼat makecho piyo timo richo mathoth.
Sunga ngʼato ema miyo opodho,
to ngʼat ma chunye muol yudo pak.
Ngʼat makonyo jakuo mondo okwal ema bedo jasike owuon;
nikech osekwongʼore kendo ok onyal bedo janeno.
Luoro mar dhano biro nyisore ni en gima duodo ngʼato,
to ngʼat mogeno kuom Jehova Nyasaye orite maonge hinyruok.
Ji mangʼeny dwaro mondo girom gi ruoth,
to en mana kuom Jehova Nyasaye ema adiera yudoree.
Joma kare mon gi joma ok jo-adiera,
to joricho mon gi joma oriere tir.
